question: When a Gaussian field exactly matches the development-set second-order spectrum of the retained clean-room Boolean reference, does its higher-order approximation remain adequate at subpixel grain scale but fail as individual grains become resolvable?

primary_sources.citation: Lesne, Gousseau, Ladjal and Newson, Neural Film Grain Rendering, Computer Graphics Forum 44(2), 2025
primary_sources.finding_used: Second-order filtered-Gaussian approximations are efficient for unresolved grain but lose higher-order Boolean texture at large visible grain sizes.

primary_sources.citation: Wang, Choudhury and Su, DeGrainVAR, CVPRW 2026
primary_sources.finding_used: Its FilmGrainStyle740k evaluation targets and DCT pretraining pairs are synthetic; they are not real-film calibration evidence.

license_and_reuse_boundary.clean_room_inputs: Only published qualitative mechanism claims plus the already retained project-owned U6.2A Boolean implementation are used.

second_order_control.spectrum: mean full 2-D periodogram of standardized development Boolean interiors, with exact conjugate-symmetric random phase and zero DC
second_order_control.normalization: each interior subtracts its own mean and divides by population RMS before spectrum or feature extraction

higher_order_features.comparison: Euclidean RMSE after feature-family scaling by development Boolean interquartile replicate spread; report each family and their median.

branch_rule.pass: Retain an evidence-bounded Boolean-to-Gaussian LOD distinction for the existing synthetic reference and open a separately frozen implementation experiment that chooses explicit geometry only when projected grain scale crosses the observed interval.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact scale boundary without tuning radii, seeds, features or gates; retain Gaussian Thomas as the generic current mechanism and require a new real or independently simulated observable before explicit geometry work.

forbidden: retune radii, seeds, feature families or gates after reading results
reinterpret the old visually rejected U6.2B composition as product-safe
claim real-film, microscopic, stock, process, scanner or density calibration
copy or execute the 2025 academic-only neural implementation
train a network or allow ML to generate final RGB
promote a renderer, profile or product default
claim_ceiling: Clean-room synthetic mechanism evidence for when an exact second-order Gaussian control ceases to reproduce higher-order statistics of the existing Boolean reference; not real-film calibration, visual safety, stock identity or product admission.
